payload.detail: PR #2072 merged into main 2026-08-18 citing this row, and the --breakpoint-phone/-tablet/-desktop plus --bp-phone/-tablet/-desktop tokens now exist in src/app/globals.css (confirmed on main) — but the row's required decision (record raw-vs-named-tokens choice in docs/design-system/GATES.md) was never made. GATES.md has not been touched since PR #1990 and contains no mention of breakpoints or #336. The row's own stop rule ('do not migrate one window ahead of the decision') was not honored; the merge shipped the migration without the decision record. Stays open: still needs the GATES.md decision entry.
